BUPATI GORONTALO
PROVINSI GORONTALO
PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN GORONTALO
NOMOR 9 TAHUN 2018
TENTANG
PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK TERHADAP TINDAK KEKERASAN  DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA
translated_text:
REGENT OF GORONTALO
GORONTALO PROVINCE
REGIONAL REGULATION OF GORONTALO REGENCY
NUMBER 9 YEAR 2018
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE
BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

text:
BUPATI GORONTALO,
Menimbang : a. bahwa Pancasila dan Undang-Undang Dasar Negera  Repuplik Indonesia Tahun 1945 menjamin atas hak setiap warga negara untuk bebas dari penyiksaan atau perlakuan yang merendahkan derajat martabat manusia serta mendapatkan rasa aman dan bebas dari segala bentuk kekerasan:
b. bahwa segala bentuk tindak kekerasan terhadap  perempuan dan anak merupakan pelanggaran hak asasi manusia sehingga perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya serta dijamin hak hidupnya sesuai dengan fitrah dan kodratnya tanpa diskriminasi,
c. bahwa pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak  merupakan urusan pemerintahan konkuren yang diserahkan ke daerah untuk menjadi dasar pelaksanaan | otonomi daerah dan menjadi urusan pemerintahan wajib  | yang tidak berkaitan dengan pelayanan dasar  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan Daerah,
d. bahwa dalam rangka untuk memberikan penguatan regulasi, arah, dan landasan dalam perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan, diperlukan pengaturan atau regulasi terkait dengan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan, -D. cd Mengingat bahwa berdasarkan pertimbangan sebagaimana dimaksud  dalam huruf a, huruf b, huruf c, dan huruf d, perlu  membentuk Peraturan Daerah tentang Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak Terhadap Tidank Kekerasan,
translated_text:
REGENT OF GORONTALO,

Considering : a. that Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia guarantee the right of every citizen to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence:

b. that all forms of acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination,

c. that women's empowerment and child protection are concurrent governmental affairs delegated to the regions to become the basis for implementing regional autonomy and become mandatory governmental affairs that are not related to basic services as referred to in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government,

d. that in order to provide regulatory strengthening, direction, and foundation in the protection of women and children victims of violence, regulation is needed related to the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence,

Observing : that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, letter c, and letter d, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Protection of Women and Children Against Acts of Violence,

translated_text:
WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE.
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Gorontalo Regency.
2. Regent is the Regent of Gorontalo.
3. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous Region.
4. Regional Governance is the administration of government affairs by the Regional Government and the Regional House of Representatives according to the principles of autonomy and assistance tasks with the principle of the widest possible autonomy within the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
5. Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old, including a child who is still in the womb.
6. Woman is a person who is female in gender.
7. Violence is any act that results in or can result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
9. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, and other violence.
10. Victim is women and children who experience misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly.
11. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will, is or has occurred.
14. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to accompany victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
15. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service unit established by the Region to provide services in the context of empowerment of women and children victims of acts of violence.
16. Safe House is a shelter for victims, during the accompaniment process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and danger from perpetrators.
17. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
18. Household is husband, wife, and children, people who have family relationships due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care, and guardianship who live in the household.
19. Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence, hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK, is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner.

text:
Pasal 2
Perlindungan Korban berasaskan:
a. penghormatan dan pemenuhan terhadap hak-hak korban,
b. keadilan dan kesetaraan gender, Cc. non diskriminasi:
d. kepentingan terbaik bagi korban, dan
e. pemberdayaan.
translated_text:
Article 2
Protection of Victims is based on:
a. respect and fulfillment of the rights of victims,
b. justice and gender equality,
c. non-discrimination,
d. the best interests of victims, and
e. empowerment.

text:
Pasal 3
Perlindungan Korban bertujuan untuk:
a. mencegah kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak,
b. memberikan pelayanan kepada Korban, dan
c. melakukan pemberdayaan kepada perempuan korban kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 3
Victim Protection aims to:
a. prevent violence against women and children,
b. provide services to Victims, and
c. carry out empowerment for women victims of violence.

text:
Pasal 4
Ruang lingkup Peraturan Daerah ini meliputi upaya pencegahan, pelayanan dan pemberdayaan terhadap korban kekerasan di Daerah.
translated_text:
Pasal 4
The scope of this Regional Regulation includes prevention efforts, services and empowerment of victims of violence in the Region.

text:
BAB II
BENTUK KEKERASAN
Pasal 5
Bentuk kekerasan antara lain:
a. kekerasan fisik,
b. kekerasan psikis, Cc. kekerasan seksual,
d. penelantaran,
e. eksploitasi, dan/atau 1 kekerasan lainnya.
translated_text:
CHAPTER II
FORMS OF VIOLENCE
Article 5
Forms of violence include:
a. physical violence,
b. psychological violence,
c. sexual violence,
d. neglect,
e. exploitation, and/or
f. other violence.

text:
Pasal 6
Kekerasan fisik sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf a cedera, luka atau cacat pada tubuh seseorang, gugurnya kandungan, pingsan dan/atau menyebabkan kematian.
translated_text:
Article 6
Physical violence as referred to in Article 5 letter a means injury, wound or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or causing death.

text:
Pasal 7
Kekerasan psikis sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf b disebabkan karena perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketakutan, hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya kemampuan untuk bertindak, rasa tidak berdaya dan/atau penderitaan psikis berat pada seseorang.
translated_text:
Article 7
Psychological violence as referred to in Article 5 letter b is caused by acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person.

text:
Pasal 8
Kekerasan seksual sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf c disebabkan karena:
a. perbuatan yang berupa pelecehan seksual, pemaksaan hubungan seksual, Cc. pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan tidak wajar atau tidak disukai, dan/atau
d. pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan orang lain untuk tujuan komersial dan atau tujuan tertentu.
translated_text:
Article 8
Sexual violence as referred to in Article 5 letter c is caused by:
a. acts in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, c. forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, and/or
d. forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and or specific purposes.

text:
Pasal 9
Penelantaran sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf d disebabkan karena:
a. perbuatan yang mengakibatkan tidak terpenuhinya kebutuhan anak secara wajar, baik fisik, mental, spiritual maupun sosial yang dilakukan oleh orang tua, wali, atau pihak lain manapun yang bertanggung jawab atas pengasuhannya,
b. perbuatan mengabaikan dengan sengaja untuk memelihara, merawat, atau mengurus anak sebagaimana mestinya yang dilakukan oleh orang tua, wali, atau pihak lain manapun yang bertanggung jawab atas pengasuhannya, Cc. perbuatan yang menelantarkan orang dalam lingkup rumah tangganya, padahal menurut hukum yang berlaku baginya atau karena persetujuan atau perjanjian ia wajib memberikan kehidupan, perawatan, atau pemeliharaan kepada orang tersebut,dan/atau,
d.
-.8- perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketergantungan ekonomi  dengan cara membatasi dan/atau melarang untuk bekerja  yang layak di dalam atau di luar rumah sehingga korban  berada dibawah kendali orang tersebut.
translated_text:
Article 9
Neglect as referred to in Article 5 letter d is caused by:
a. acts that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of a child properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care,
b. acts of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or look after a child as appropriate, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care,
c. acts of neglecting a person within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person, and/or,
d. acts that result in economic dependence by means of restricting and/or prohibiting from working appropriately inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

text:
Pasal 10
Eksploitasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf e  disebabkan karena:
a. perbuatan yang mengeksploitasi ekonomi atau seksual  dengan maksud untuk menguntungkan diri sendiri atau  orang lain, perbuatan yang dengan atau tanpa persetujuan korban yang  meliputi tapi tidak terbatas pada pelacuran, kerja atau  pelayanan paksa, perbudakan atau praktik serupa,  penindasan, pemerasan, pemanfaatan fisik, seksual, organ reproduksi, atau secara melawan hukum memindahkan atau  mentransplantasi organ dan/atau jaringan tubuh atau  memanfaatkan tenaga atau kemampuan seseorang oleh  pihak lain untuk mendapatkan keuntungan baik materiil  maupun immateriil,dan /atau segala bentuk pemanfaatan organ tubuh seksual atau organ  tubuh lain dari korban untuk mendapatkan keuntungan,  termasuk tetapi tidak terbatas pada semua kegiatan  pelacuran atau pencabulan.
translated_text:
Article 10
Exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter e is caused by:
a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others, acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or capabilities of a person by other parties to obtain benefits both material and immaterial, and/or all forms of utilization of sexual organs or other organs of the victim's body to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or indecent acts.

text:
Pasal 11
Kekerasan lainnya sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 5 huruf f  disebabkan karena:
a. ancaman kekerasan yang meliputi setiap perbuatan secara  melawan hukum berupa ucapan, tulisan, gambar, simbol,  atau gerakan tubuh, baik dengan atau tanpa menggunakan  sarana yang menimbulkan rasa takut atau mengekang  kebebasan hakiki seseorang,dan pemaksaan, meliputi: suatu keadaan dimana  seseorang/korban disuruh melakukan sesuatu sedemikian  rupa sehingga orang itu melakukan sesuatu yang  berlawanan dengan kehendak sendiri.
-.9-
translated_text:
Article 11
Other violence as referred to in Article 5 letter f is caused by:
a. threat of violence which includes any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom, and coercion, includes: a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something that is contrary to their own will.
-.9-

text:
BAB III
HAK KORBAN
Pasal 12
Setiap Korban mendapatkan hak: untuk dihormati harkat dan martabatnya sebagai manusia,  a.
pemulihan kesehatan dan psikologis dari penderitaan yang  b.
dialami korban: menentukan sendiri keputusannya, mendapatkan informasi, kerahasiaan identitasnya, kompensasi, rehabilitasi sosial, penanganan pengaduan, peta mendapatkan kemudahan dalam proses peradilan, dan/atau  pendampingan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER III
RIGHTS OF VICTIMS
Article 12
Every Victim obtains the right: to have their dignity and worth as a human being respected, a.
restoration of health and psychological recovery from the suffering b.
experienced by the victim: to determine their own decision, to obtain information, confidentiality of their identity, compensation, social rehabilitation, handling of complaints, to obtain facilitation in the judicial process, and/or assistance.

text:
Pasal 13
Anak korban kekerasan selain mendapatkan hak sebagaimana  dimaksud dalam Pasal 12, juga mendapatkan hak khusus, yang  terdiri atas:
a. penghormatan atas kelangsungan hidup, tumbuh dan  berkembang, pelayanan dasar, perlindungan yang sama, bebas dari berbagai stigma, dan/atau mendapatkan kebebasan.
translated_text:
Article 13
Child victims of violence, in addition to receiving the rights as referred to in Article 12, also receive special rights, consisting of:
a. respect for survival, growth and development, basic services, equal protection, freedom from various stigma, and/or obtaining freedom.

text:
BAB IV
KEWAJIBAN DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB
Bagian Kesatu
Pemerintah Daerah
translated_text:
CHAPTER IV
OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Part One
Regional Government

text:
Pasal 14
(1) Pemerintah Daerah wajib dan bertanggung jawab untuk  melaksanakan upaya perlindungan perempuan dan anak  korban kekerasan melalui:
a. penetapan kebijakan,
b. penyusunan perencanaan program dan kegiatan: -10-
d. memberikan dukungan sarana dan prasarana, dan
e. mengalokasikan anggaran,
f. pembentukan forum Anak, dan
g. pembentukan Satuan Tugas.
(2) Untuk mengantisipasi terjadinya tindak kekerasan,  Pemerintah Daerah menyelenggarakan layanan bagi  korban dalam bentuk:
a. memfasilitasi pembentukan P2TP2A,
b. memfasilitasi sarana dan prasarana P2TP2A sesuai  kemampuan Daerah, dan
c. memfasilitasi Satuan Tugas sebagai wadah jejaring  penanganan Korban.
translated_text:

text:
PENJELASAN
ATAS

NOMOR 4. TAHUN 2018
TENTANG
PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK TERHADAP TINDAK KEKERASAN
Il. UMUM Tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak merupakan pelanggaran  hak asasi manusia sehingga perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya  serta dijamin hak hidupnya sesuai dengan fitrah dan kodratnya tanpa  diskriminasi.
Dalam rangka mencegah dan menanggulangi kekerasan terhadap  perempuan dan anak di Kabupaten Gorontalo agar terhindar dari  kekerasan, ancaman kekerasan, penyiksaan atau perlakuan yang  merendahkan derajat dan martabat kemanusiaan, perlu dilakukan  perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan dalam  bentuk peraturan di Daerah.
Selama ini peraturan perundang-undangan yang mengatur mengenai  perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan belum mengatur  upaya-upaya perlindungan di Daerah sehingga diperlukan dukungan  kelembagaan dan peraturan yang dapat menjamin pelaksanaannya.
Peraturan Daerah ini mengatur upaya perlindungan bagi korban  khususnya dalam hal pencegahan, pelayanan dan pemberdayaan terhadap  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan di Kabupaten Gorontalo.

CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN AGAINST ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Il. GENERAL Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gorontalo Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not yet regulated protection measures at the Regional level, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee their implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection measures for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and children victims of violence in Gorontalo Regency.

Huruf b Cukup jelas.

Sa) | 2 Huruf d Yang dimaksud dengan “mendapatkan informasi” adalah hak mendapatkan keterangan, pernyataan, gagasan, dan tanda tanda yang mengandung nilai, makna, dan pesan, baik data, fakta maupun penjelasannya yang dapat dilihat, didengar, dan dibaca yang disajikan dalam berbagai kemasan dan format sesuai dengan perkembangan teknologi informasi dan komunikasi secara elektronik ataupun non elektronik yang terkait tindak kekerasan.
Huruf e Cukup jelas.
Huruf f Yang dimaksud dengan “kompensasi” meliputi: pemberdayaan ekonomi, biaya pemulangan, jaminan kesehatan, dan pendidikan atau ketrampilan.
Huruf g Yang dimaksud dengan “rehabilitasi sosial” meliputi: akses pada layanan medis untuk pemulihan fisik dan psikologis, bantuan hukum untuk mengembalikan hak-hak keperdataan, pemulihan nama baik, dan kewarganegaraan.
Huruf h Yang dimaksud dengan “penanganan pengaduan” adalah tersedianya unit khusus layanan terpadu oleh petugas.
Huruf i Cukup jelas.
Huruf'j Yang dimaksud dengan “pendampingan” antara lain: psikolog, psikiater, ahli kesehatan, rohaniawan, advokat, dan anggota keluarga.
translated_text:
Article 12
Letter a What is meant by "to be respected for their dignity as a human being" is upholding human rights.
Letter b Sufficiently clear.
Letter c Sufficiently clear.
Sa) | 2 Letter d What is meant by "obtaining information" is the right to obtain explanations, statements, ideas, and signs that contain value, meaning, and messages, whether data, facts or their explanations that can be seen, heard, and read which are presented in various packages and formats in accordance with the development of information and communication technology either electronically or non-electronically related to acts of violence.
Letter e Sufficiently clear.
Letter f What is meant by "compensation" includes: economic empowerment, repatriation costs, health insurance, and education or skills training.
Letter g What is meant by "social rehabilitation" includes: access to medical services for physical and psychological recovery, legal aid to restore civil rights, restoration of good name, and citizenship.
Letter h What is meant by "complaint handling" is the availability of a special integrated service unit by officers.
Letter i Sufficiently clear.
Letter j What is meant by "assistance" includes among others: psychologists, psychiatrists, health experts, religious counselors, advocates, and family members.

Letter b What is meant by "basic services" includes among others: the right to education, health and access to parents during the handling process.
